tickets.title: Repair unattended/07: permission proof narrows unproven forms to main instead of approving them
tickets.live_try: In a scratch herdr pane bound to a synthetic job, show Claude Bash prompts for (a) `S=<scratchpad>; rm -rf $S/out` (approved once), (b) the same with the worktree's `scratchpad` a symlink to a user-owned directory outside the job (main), (c) `test -d sub && cd sub; rm -f x` (main), (d) `npm run release` in the worktree (main), (e) `cp a.txt <worktree>/dir/` (main unless the derived child is proven): only (a) gets a key press; the others reach main with recommendation and answer action.
tickets.what: Milestone review j052818360e2b58a8 findings 7-10 and its deletion list, `src/mcp/permission-policy.ts`. Prefer narrowing unsupported forms to main over growing a shell interpreter; spec §2.1 approves only what is proven confined and reversible, anything unsure goes to main. (7) `resolveRoots` (~125-153) realpaths `worktree/scratchpad` and `task/scratchpad` and trusts the destination on a UID match; a symlinked scratchpad makes an outside directory a deletion root. Anchor each derived root beneath its verified job parent (realpath must stay inside it). (8) `tokenizeShell`/`proveShellPrompt` (~322-380, ~1297-1315, ~1350-1359) flatten conditionals and persist assignments/`cd` as if executed; only allow state-bearing sequences (assignment, cd) when every earlier separator is unconditional and not in a pipeline; otherwise main. (9) `validateCpMv` (~643-691) checks the destination directory, not the derived child; `validateTar`/`validateUnzip` (~773-876) do not check extracted members. Prove the effective child target (no existing symlink, recoverable or new) or send to main; tar/unzip without proven member lists go to main. (10) `npm run <script>` and `npx tsc` (~1044-1158) are not evidence of a local-only effect: hand them to main unless a trusted confined route exists (e.g. `npx --no-install tsc` with a local `node_modules/.bin/tsc` inside the worktree); arbitrary script names go to main. Delete the old PNG-only `permissionDirectory`, the root-string `permissionProof` adapter and the string branch of `normalizeProof` (~110, ~1418, ~1431); tests use the structured proof. Update docs/reference.md and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §5 where the approved set changes; ticket 07's acceptance item that listed `npm run build` as auto-approved is superseded by this narrowing. Verify line numbers at HEAD first.

acceptance.text: Tests: symlinked scratchpad, conditional `cd`/assignment before `;`, `cp` into a directory with an existing child symlink, tar/unzip without member list, `npm run release` and `npx tsc` without a proven local binary all go to main
Tests: `S=<scratchpad>; rm -rf $S/out`, `mkdir -p`/`cp` to explicit new targets inside the worktree and a Claude Edit file inside the worktree are still approved
The legacy string proof path is removed and no test passes a bare string as a verified proof
docs/reference.md and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md describe the narrowed approved set

tickets.what: Owner decision D-2026-11-27-02 after milestone review j297aaffd5e903d3d (run q2e663015e61f3272, cancelled). Delete, do not patch: the proof in `src/mcp/permission-policy.ts` (~1,350 lines) and `src/mcp/worker-permissions.ts` keeps growing into a shell and Git interpreter. Remove these branches so the forms go to main: (1) git `add`/`commit`/`stash`/`rebase` from `ALLOWED_GIT_SUBS` (~:11, ~1043-1133); Git read subcommands accept only known options; (2) recursive chmod/traversal and recursive search, and nonrecursive chmod on multiply-linked files (~762-795, ~934-996); (3) any proof that carries `cd` or assignment state across `;`/`&&` into a mutation (~1186-1188, ~1242-1250), except the literal `S=<abs>; rm ... $S/...` form ticket 08 kept; (4) native edit prompts with a relative heading path: use the displayed cwd when unambiguous, else main; never substitute the process cwd (`worker-permissions.ts` ~126-161, ~360-363); (5) external scratch and temp roots that lack a verified real parent bound to the job (`worker-permissions.ts` ~340-359, `permission-policy.ts` ~116-158): drop them from automatic deletion proof; the derived worktree scratchpad stays. Also: bare shell verbs must resolve to a trusted system path, not a project-local executable (~348-363), or go to main. Keep: the structured-only Decision API input, recoverable-byte check, bounded ledger, spend-before-send, fresh menu/selection check, worktree explicit new-file create/edit, scratchpad deletion, read-only commands with known options and read-only filter pipes. Net line count of the two files must go down. Update docs/reference.md (permission section, ~677-687) and the Decision API input table (~1347) to the narrowed set.

acceptance.text: Fixture tests: each of review j297aaffd5e903d3d blockers 1-5 goes to main (one case per blocker), and the kept forms (scratchpad rm via S=<abs>, worktree absolute-path Edit/create, read-only command with a filter pipe) still get one automatic answer
permission-policy.ts plus worker-permissions.ts have fewer lines than at 9583cd22
docs/reference.md lists the narrowed approved set and nothing it no longer approves

tickets.title: Close the permission-handoff and notice delivery holes from the last unattended review
tickets.what: Review j297aaffd5e903d3d majors 6-10 plus open lead todos (run q2e663015e61f3272, cancelled; its repair budget was spent). Verify line numbers at HEAD. (6) `src/mcp/report-notes.ts` ~159-169 ends an inline field at a same-indent next line, so a soft-wrapped `Blockers: owner live try remains: ...` + `and pick which layout ships` is classified as a try: collect through the Markdown paragraph/field boundary before classifying, or keep ambiguous continuation as a blocker. (7) `src/roles/notify.ts` ~187-209 types the message after any unsuccessful `codex queue` result, including timeout and lost reply (`src/roles/herdr-run.ts`): fall back only on positive non-send evidence; propagate indeterminate. (8) `src/cli/watch.ts` ~67-70, ~470-600 treats a permission notice as a row delta and advances `prev` before delivery, so a confirmed non-send or expired guarded retry loses the hand-off: use one durable per-entry delivery claim shared by watcher and direct paths (`src/runtime/watch-runtime.ts` ~294-324), release only on confirmed non-send, and prune `.noticed` markers with the 12-entry ledger. (9) `src/mcp/ticket-queue-step.ts` ~53, ~73-92, ~1421-1437 disables the project permission outbox because historical `q.pane` is non-empty after the origin died: choose by live recipient availability. (10) `src/mcp/mcp/tasks.ts` ~443-470 prefers the global marker epoch/expiry over the caller's receipt: check the caller's own receipt epoch against the flow before poll/cancel/re-claim. Also: (11) `hud_respond` on run q2e663015e61f3272 paused with `handback {kind: escalate, step: accept}` returned `no_pending_handback` (2026-11-27); an escalate pause must be answerable with resume/stop. (12) Check `judgeSettlement` (`ticket-queue-step.ts` ~148) cannot wait forever when a report is rewritten after settlement; add a bound or a notice.

acceptance.text: Tests for each of items 6-12: soft-wrapped Blockers stays a blocker; an indeterminate codex queue send is not retyped; a refused watcher hand-off is redelivered once and .noticed markers stay bounded; a pane-less successor still notifies project main; a stale caller receipt cannot poll a newer epoch's task; hud_respond answers an escalate accept pause; a rewritten report cannot wait forever
docs/reference.md matches the changed delivery rules
